posts.title: Some personal thoughts on our national tragedy
posts.description: Outside the Al Huda Mosque near my home (by Mark McGuire ) A year ago, my wife and I decided to become citizens of New Zealand. Both of our sons were born here and are full, native Kiwis. It felt odd for our family not to have this in common, and besides, our own connection with New Zealand had grown strong over the happy decade we'd lived here. It was time to take the plunge.
